What I want to verify: Users only have the access their roles require.
Evidence I would ask for: Approved role matrix, user access export, access approval or role-change records
How I would check it: Compare approved access with actual access and investigate any extra permissions against approval or role-change records.
When to review: Quarterly or after a role change

What I want to verify: Privileged accounts are approved, reviewed, separated from standard use, protected with MFA, and monitored.
Evidence I would ask for: Privileged account inventory, privileged access report, MFA settings, activity review notes
How I would check it: Confirm ownership and review, admin account separation, MFA, and documented monitoring.
When to review: Quarterly or after an admin role change

What I want to verify: Network zones are defined and traffic between them follows approved rules.
Evidence I would ask for: Network diagram, VLAN list, firewall rule export, approved traffic matrix
How I would check it: Compare the network diagram and approved traffic matrix with the deployed firewall and ACL rules.
When to review: After network changes or annual review

What I want to verify: Remote access is limited to approved users and approved internal paths.
Evidence I would ask for: VPN user list, remote access policy, authentication settings, firewall or VPN configuration
How I would check it: Confirm who can connect, how they authenticate, and which internal systems they can reach.
When to review: Quarterly or after a remote access change

What I want to verify: Critical security events are collected and reviewed.
Evidence I would ask for: SIEM log source list, sample alerts, alert review notes, ingestion validation
How I would check it: Confirm required sources are sending events and that alerts or review records show the data is being used.
When to review: Monthly or after a log source change

What I want to verify: Backups run successfully and selected data can be restored.
Evidence I would ask for: Backup job logs, restore test report, restored sample details, recovery procedure
How I would check it: Confirm what was restored, when it was tested, whether it succeeded, and whether follow-up work was needed.
When to review: Quarterly or after a major system change

What I want to verify: Network and firewall changes are approved, implemented as authorized, and reflected in the baseline.
Evidence I would ask for: Change request, approval record, implementation evidence, validation results, baseline configuration
How I would check it: Match the request and approval to the deployed change, validation result, and updated baseline.

Controls: CA-5 Plan of Action and Milestones
What I want to verify: Remediation items have an owner, target date, closure requirements, and evidence-backed validation before they are closed.
Evidence I would ask for: Remediation tracker, closure evidence for closed items, validation records
How I would check it: Confirm each item has an owner, target date, status, and closure requirements; for closed items, confirm retained evidence and validation support closure.
